props.heading: The cite-or-refuse prompt
props.prompt: For every factual claim, name the specific real source it comes from (title, author/site, date). If you can't point to a real, checkable source, don't make the claim — say "I couldn't verify this." Never invent citations, quotes, case names, numbers, or links.
props.hint: ⧉ pause & screenshot · full text in the description
